title: Linear systems as one matrix equation, and the operations that preserve its solutions
objectives: State the field axioms and say which one each elimination step uses
Prove that equivalent systems have the same solutions
Write each elementary row operation as multiplication by an invertible elementary matrix
Row-reduce any matrix and read the solutions of the system
prerequisites: Matrix computation and school-level elimination of linear equations.
source_scope: The captions of the course promo and Lectures 1 and 2 were read in full; the running example, the proofs as written, the counterexamples and the exercises are original.
